gloss: to swim around, to swim about

definitions.explanation: To swim in various directions; to swim about an area.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}が{水槽|すいそう}の{中|なか}を{泳|およ}ぎ{回|まわ}っている。
examples.english: The fish are swimming around in the tank.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちがプールで{泳|およ}ぎ{回|まわ}っていた。
examples.english: The children were swimming around in the pool.

examples.japanese: イルカが{船|ふね}の{周|まわ}りを{泳|およ}ぎ{回|まわ}った。

notes:
A compound verb meaning to swim around freely or in various directions.

COMPOUND VERB:
Formed from {泳|およ}ぐ (to swim) + {回|まわ}る (to go around). The ～{回|まわ}る pattern indicates movement in various directions or throughout an area.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive)
- The subject (fish, person, etc.) moves freely through water

ASPECT (ている):
{泳|およ}ぎ{回|まわ}っている describes the ongoing action of swimming around, emphasizing continuous movement in multiple directions.

SIMILAR ～{回|まわ}る COMPOUNDS:
- {走|はし}り{回|まわ}る: to run around
- {歩|ある}き{回|まわ}る: to walk around
- {飛|と}び{回|まわ}る: to fly around
- {動|うご}き{回|まわ}る: to move around
